one_line: Factual contradictions in vLLM and SpecAgent headlines; three takes share one syntactic frame.

findings.quote: Halve agent serving costs by letting a small model do the drafting
findings.instruction: The verification flags this claim as unsupported: the source supports halving wall time (41-54% of large-model wall time on τ²-Bench), not halving costs. Rewrite the headline to reflect the wall-time / decoding-load finding, e.g. 'Cut agent decoding time in half by letting a small model draft tool-use steps'.

findings.quote: Multiple connection handling delivers 43-85% more requests per second on short inputs.
findings.instruction: The verification flags this as contradicted: the 43-85% req/s lift is specifically tied to running --api-server-count above 1 (least-loaded worker routing), not to 'multiple connection handling' as a general feature. Rewrite to: 'Running multiple API workers with --api-server-count delivers 43-85% more requests per second on short inputs (Qwen3-0.6B, 32-token input).' Keep the benchmark anchor so the claim is falsifiable.

findings.quote: Teams building on frontier-scale open weights previously had no RL and fine-tuning recipes on day one.
findings.instruction: The take states a historical absence ('previously had no') rather than a present-tense editorial position. Rewrite as a present-tense declarative: e.g. 'Beam ships frontier-scale open weights with RL and fine-tuning recipes on day one, removing the standing gap.' Must parse as 'It is now the case that [take]'.

findings.quote: Interpretability research assumed tangled weights were permanent; one essay challenges that baseline.
findings.instruction: The take hedges with 'one essay challenges' rather than stating the publication's position. The body already notes it is a single researcher's working theory with no paper or replication. The take should state what the publication holds true about the significance, not merely that a challenge exists. Rewrite to a declarative position, e.g. 'Polysemanticity's status as a fixed constraint is now contested at the research frontier, warranting a roadmap review.' Keep within 18 words.

findings.quote: Open-weight model vetting assumed weight editing was a safety concern, not a supply-chain one.
findings.instruction: This take shares the same syntactic scaffold as the Pulse take and the Redwood take: '[domain] assumed [X] was [A], not [B].' Three takes in the issue share this frame, which triggers a major under the criterion — but this is the second instance; flag the third (Redwood) as major. Here, rewrite to break the frame: e.g. 'Abliteration has moved open-weight backdoor risk from a safety category into a supply-chain one that most model-risk processes do not yet own.'

findings.quote: Agent monitor red-teaming shifted from expert hours to an automated transcript-editing loop.
findings.instruction: This is the third take in the issue using the '[X] shifted/assumed [A]; now [B]' scaffold (Pulse: 'previously had no'; supply-chain take: 'assumed … not'; this one: 'shifted from … to'). Three or more shared frames is a major. Rewrite to break the pattern: e.g. 'Screwtape makes monitor gap discovery a repeatable pipeline, not a specialist exercise — six confirmed evasions in 252 automated runs.'

findings.quote: When earnings season compresses analyst time this sharply, which parts of your process still require a human?
findings.instruction: The closing strategic question is anchored to the reader's process, which is in-voice. However, 'which parts of your process still require a human?' has an obvious implied answer (compliance sign-off, client relationships) and reads as rhetorical rather than decision-forcing. Sharpen to a specific role or constraint: e.g. 'Which analyst role in your org owns the judgment call that a five-page automated report cannot make?'

findings.quote: The preprint and code are public on GitHub today.
findings.instruction: The Currents body must end on a presence-form maturity signal — what exists and what it is worth today. The current close is a bare availability statement, not a maturity assessment. Rewrite the final sentence to characterise the evidence's current value: e.g. 'The preprint and code are public today; the τ²-Bench result is the only replication point, so treat the cost claim as directional until a second benchmark confirms it.'

findings.quote: vLLM v0.32.0 replaces per-model parser forks with a universal template reader, lifting throughput 43-85% on short inputs.
findings.instruction: The throughput claim here repeats the contradicted framing in the story body ('lifting throughput 43-85% on short inputs' without the --api-server-count condition). Rewrite to match the corrected body: 'vLLM v0.32.0 replaces per-model parser forks with a universal template reader; running multiple API workers lifts req/s 43-85% on short inputs.'

findings.quote: Vercel adds a free open reasoning model for agentic coding
findings.instruction: This story covers the same model (Reflection AI Beam) as the Pulse story (c_d3c1dbe5bfb3022e), differing only in the access vector (Vercel Gateway vs. self-hosted weights). Running two stories on the same model release in the same issue — one as Pulse, one as Hands-On — creates redundancy that a reader will notice. Consider whether this story adds enough distinct practitioner value (the CLI invocation path) to justify a separate slot, or whether the Vercel access detail should be folded into the Pulse summary as a deployment note.

The verification block is clean for this story, but 200K GitHub stars for a tool described as connecting Claude Code to Ghidra via MCP is an extraordinary claim — this would place it among the most-starred repositories on GitHub. Confirm the star count against the live repo before publishing; if the figure is correct, add a parenthetical noting it includes forks or mirrors if applicable. If unverifiable, remove the star count.

note: verdict rule: major >= 3 (Three substantive editorial defects is not three fixes, it is a draft that did not come out right. Re-summarise beats patching.) | 1 finding(s) dropped: malformed shape
